natures.label: Rule / policy the division creates and manages
natures.description: Standing rules, norms, specifications, schemes, SOPs, delegations and guidelines issued and maintained by the division.

natures.label: Forwarded Government order
natures.description: Orders and rates decided elsewhere (Ministry, DoPT, Finance, Gazette) that the division circulates or applies. The division does not create the rule.

natures.label: Routine administration or operations
natures.description: Seniority lists, examinations, appointments, orders, allocations, programmes, meetings and similar day-to-day work.

natures.label: Data request or return
natures.description: Information, returns, reports or data called for from field offices.

natures.label: Data dissemination or reply
natures.description: Replies and information given out: RTI replies, Parliament questions, publications.

natures.label: Communication with field offices
natures.description: Reminders, advisories, notices, observances, announcements and instructions to offices.

natures_method: Each topic row was labelled by hand from its description (primary nature, plus a secondary where the topic mixes kinds of work). The division mix is an estimate from circular titles using keyword rules (individual cases such as named-officer orders count as routine); it is approximate and Hindi-only titles are classified on Hindi keywords.
